# @yaebal/cache

> 标签: cache, memoization, telegram, telegram-bot, ttl, yaebal

## 简介

yaebal cache — ctx.cache.get/set/wrap with stale-while-revalidate, sliding expiry, negative caching, prefix invalidation, namespaces, and an optional typed key catalog, built on @yaebal/sklad storage adapters.
